chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Abu Talib, from Yunus ibn Bakkar, from his father, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام.
And if they had done what they were admonished to do regarding Ali, it would surely have been better for them.

key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Ali; the subject concerning whom the exhortation is understood
key_terms.لَهُمْ: for them; showing the benefit returns to the people themselves

ai.seo_question: How is the verse about doing what they were admonished understood in relation to Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report presents a Quranic phrase as referring to what people were exhorted to do concerning Imam Ali عليه السلام. Its significance lies in linking obedience in the matter of his wilayah with goodness and benefit for the community.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from his father, from Abu Talib, from Yunus Bin Bakr, from his father, from Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
[4:66] and if they had done what they were Advised, it would have certainly been better for them’.
en.sarwar: 28. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from his father from abu Talib from Yunus ibn Bakkar from his father from Jabir from abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who has said the following. “
If they had done what they had been advised to do (acknowledge Ali’s Leadership with Divine Authority), it would have been for their good and to strengthen their faith.” [4:66]
